name: an inferred sensitive fact is held for review even though Lever A commits inferred facts
description: I5 sensitive-inference net (ENTITY_GRAPH_INGEST_V2 §5, T1.2): Lever A retired the weight-ceiling review gate, so inferred facts now commit by default — EXCEPT on a clearly-sensitive predicate. A general note ('been really down, could barely get out of bed') never states a mood value; the model INFERS mood=depressed (inferred=true). Because `mood` is a deterministically floored-sensitive predicate (domain_floor -> health), two things must hold together: (1) the fact is floored into the HEALTH domain even though the note is general (firewall hardening, T1.3), and (2) it is held pending_review behind a low_confidence_inference card rather than silently committing an inferred mental-health state. A non-sensitive inferred fact in the same note (an implied hobby) commits active — proving the hold is the sensitive net, not a blanket inferred gate.

steps.body: Been really down this week — could barely get out of bed. Did manage to noodle on the guitar for a bit though.
